name: Dukes
description: The Dukes were a gang from East Harlem, possibly Italian in composition. They were involved in fights and gang violence with rival gangs in the area during the 1950s, most notably the Dragons. On June 11, 1956, the Dukes were involved in a gang shooting against the Dragons, in which Victor Serrano, a member of the Dragons, was shot.
